description: The Bus Stops is a dataset listed in Prince George's County open data portal (data.princegeorgescountymd.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Prince George's County. Prince George's County operates TheBus, a County bus service, to meet local transportation needs of its residents and visitors. TheBus' fixed route system consists of 28 routes that cover more than 10,000 miles throughout the County. TheBus operates Monday through Friday. Coverage: Prince George's County, Maryland. The portal files it under the category Geographic. Its tags are transportation, bus stop. The table has 15 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-princegeorgescountymd-gov-portal.
